Aura Fishing - Game Design Math workbook: Generated from the game's config and formula code. Every number is read from src/shared/Config; every formula mirrors the Luau code named in the Source column.

column2: Yellow cells are inputs/tuning numbers. Change one and the formulas recalculate. Green cells are key results. Blue-grey bars are section titles.
Import into Google Sheets: File > Import > Upload > choose this .xlsx > 'Insert new sheet(s)' (or 'Replace spreadsheet'). Formulas and dropdowns are kept.

Defaults: Stats Calculator is pre-filled with an endgame build (Celestial Rod, Star Line, Pearl Bait, Abyssal Shadow). Fishing Loop, Aquarium and Auras read their stats from it, so set the build first. Fish Odds defaults to depth 80 m, Luck 0.5.
Changing a value here does NOT change the game. To apply a balance change, edit the value in the config file named in the Source column.

Fishing Loop and Fish Odds are expected-value estimates, not a simulation. Player behaviour (reel time, perfect rate) is an input.
Hot fish and the Tide event are random/time-based in the game; here they are parameters.
Server rounding: the game stores each catch's value rounded, then sells the stack total x multipliers; very large stacks can differ by a few coins.
Prices of Robux products are display values; the real price is set on the Creator Hub.
Dev-only content (Dev config) and UI/Figma values are not included.
